content:
maria: pushed a small follow-up to PR #3456 to address the concurrency nil-check you flagged. PTAL when you have a minute. Summary: added guard, expanded unit test, and added a short comment explaining the race condition

alex: thanks — quick q: did you reproduce the flake locally or only saw it in CI?

maria: reproduced locally with stress test: `go test ./pkg/runtime -run TestAllocatorRace -race -count=50` — fails ~1/30 runs. The added guard made it stable in my runs.

jordan: skimmed the diff, the extra comment helps. two tiny nits (naming + docstring) but nothing blocking. otherwise lgtm.

maria: addressed both nits in the last commit and pushed. also rebased onto main to avoid the merge conflict I hit earlier.

alex: can you paste the exact commands you ran for the stress test? I want to run it on my laptop quick.

maria: sure:
```
# reproduce flaky allocator locally
git checkout fix/allocator-nil-guard
go test ./pkg/runtime -run TestAllocatorRace -race -count=50
# if you want to run the specific seed that failed for me:
GOTEST_SHORT=1 go test ./pkg/runtime -run TestAllocatorRace -race -count=1 -run TestAllocatorRace -test.run TestAllocatorRace -test.seed=12345
```

eng-ci-bot: ci/circleci: build #7845 passed — all checks green (:party:)

alex: running the stress test now, will post if I see anything.

sre-oncall: quick note — canary merges happen at 18:00 UTC today, we should aim to merge before 17:45 if this needs to be in the canary. otherwise we can wait for the normal deploy tomorrow.

jordan: since CI is green and the fixes are tiny, i'm fine with merge. alex, do you want to take a look before i hit merge?

alex: gave it one run, looks stable locally. PTAL means go ahead in my book. :+1: merge when you have a free slot.

maria: thanks all — i'll merge at 17:30 UTC then and ping #deploys for the canary. will open a follow-up if anything shows up.

jordan: cool, thanks for the quick turnaround.

eng-ci-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary at 18:00 UTC (will post status in #deploys)
